inventory_boundary.reason: Fresh-context v18 inventory enumerates every atomic display series and independent quantitative/analytic claim in the full paper.

acceptance_criteria: Every declared atomic numerical claim is linked to an executable target and a named scientific check.
The Fig. 1 bands come only from independent diagonalization of the printed Hamiltonian; no author code, arrays, digitized coordinates, or source pixels enter the numerical runner.
The spin Chern numbers are computed from occupied Bloch eigenvectors on a periodic Fukui grid rather than returned as constants.
The Fig. 2 coefficients are computed from explicit spin-resolved Landauer-Buettiker transmission graphs rather than returned as constants.
The configured nearest-neighbour Rashba coupling changes the full spinful ribbon spectrum while Hermiticity, time reversal, and the edge Kramers degeneracy remain within tolerance.
Every declared subcritical zigzag and armchair Rashba branch is resolved by adaptive full-k edge-overlap tracking at three increasing widths.

A claimed translation-preserving bulk path is accepted only after continuous direct-gap minimization; a falsified minimal candidate is reported as publication-underspecified rather than passed on a coarse grid.
The isolated runner records zero forbidden access to raw and reference artifacts.
All ten atomic gaps map once to executable formula output or a strict indispensable-input contract.
Reduced execution proves code readiness only and never promotes publication-underspecified results to scientific coverage.
The numerical campaign reads no paper PDF, author code, author arrays, reference pixels, or legacy outputs.
